meta.title: BrightSmile Dental Clinic
meta.description: Gentle dentistry in Heliopolis, Cairo, with clear prices and an assistant that answers questions and books visits at any hour.

home.lead: Gentle dentistry with clear prices, and an assistant that answers your questions and books your visit at any hour.

story.p: Prices, insurance, hours, what to do before a visit. The assistant answers from the clinic's own information.

story.h: Real free slots, not a phone queue.
story.p: Choose Dr. Sarah or Dr. Karim and a time that is actually open. No double-booking.
Fewer no-shows. If you can't come, your slot goes to the next patient on the waitlist.
Everything was ready before you arrived.

portal.title: Come in. Dr. Sarah will see you now.

xray.title: See what we see.
xray.text: Move the lens across the teeth. A check-up finds the small things before they become big ones.

journey.title: Your visit, start to finish.
journey.text: From a late-night question to your six-month check-up, nothing falls through the cracks.

ticks: Answers from the clinic's own prices, hours and policies, and shows where each answer came from.
Sees the real calendar, so it never double-books.
Sends a reminder the day before, in Arabic or English.
